identificationModule.briefTitle: Orelabrutinib Plus Rituximab Followed by Maintenance With Orelabrutinib for Relapsed and Refractory Follicular Lymphoma(RR FL)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Orelabrutinib Plus Rituximab Followed by Maintenance With Orelabrutinib for Relapsed and Refractory Follicular Lymphoma(RR FL) ：a Single Arm, Open Label, Multi-center Phase II Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This phase 2 trial studies the efficacy and safety of orelabrutinib plus rituximab followed by maintenance with orelabrutinib for relapsed and refractory follicular lymphoma(RR FL)

armGroups.label: Orelabrutinib plus Rituximab followed by Maintenance with Orelabrutinib
armGroups.description:
Induction therapy: Patients receive Orelabrutinib at a dose of 25 mg once daily on days 1-28 and rituximab at a dose of 375mg/m2 on day 1. Treatment cycles repeat every 28 days for up to 6 cycles in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

If patients achieve CR or PR or SD, they will be treated with maintenance therapy Maintenance therapy: Patients receive Orelabrutinib every day at a dose of 150mg for up to two years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

interventions.description: Orelabrutinib 150mg po qd d1-28; Rituximab 375mg/m2 iv.drip d1.
